summary: Standing aside looks right after the close. Hot October CPI (+0.4% m/m, December hike odds 82-99%) gave a mild session, not the rates shock I had stress-tested: SPY's close is about -0.37% (from spy_value 589.21 to 587.04, so roughly 750 against the 727.98 200-day line, about 3.0% of cushion). BND was -0.71%, IEF -0.83%, VNQ -0.23%. Equity was 622.55 (-1.08, -0.17%). That beat SPY and trailed the 99.5%-invested shadow, which was about -0.03%. Since v5 started on 11-03 the agent is +0.89%, against -0.09% for the shadow and -0.59% for SPY, so the roughly 11.5% cash has not cost anything yet. Cash did not rise, so the Skeptic's test for deploying (cash above about $80) was not met and INCY stays a candidate for later. No stored invalidation tripped. These are the close marks from close.json market_value/qty: BND 71.11 vs $70.0 (1.6% above), IEF 91.04 vs 89.5 (1.7%), VNQ 97.08 vs $92.0 (5.2%), DPZ 330.06 vs $300 (9.1%), IDXX 696.6 vs $640 (8.1%), MSM 119.30 vs about $108.0 (9.4%), VRSN 312.0 vs 278 (10.9%), CARG 34.59 vs about $28.25, and FAST 54.33, KR 68.60, MSCI 656.9 and WMT 125.68, all well clear of their fill-based stops. RSP's 21-day return is +3.71%, so the VOO broadening clause is untripped. TLT is 1.02% below its 200-day and IEF 0.40% below, so the VNQ and BND rate clauses are untripped. The three thesis_updates held up: VNQ is now anchored to the actual $96.81 fill as L1 asks, and the higher DPZ and IDXX stops stayed 8-9% away on a day when both fell more than 1%. Weak points: (1) The decision reasoning did not say whether two qualitative clauses had tripped. BND's 'Market Analyst risk-on while TLT and IEF both more than 3% below their 200-day' had half its condition live (the analyst is risk-on) and was not mentioned. IEF's 'a hawkish Fed outcome pushes yields materially higher' was close to live on a hot-CPI day. Both are untripped, but L5 asks for that to be stated. (2) Stale wording is still stored and was not fixed. MSM still reads 'roughly $108 only if it fills near the menu close'. It filled at exactly $118.72, so the level is $108.0 and should be written that way, the same pattern L1 fixed for VNQ today. IEF and BND theses still refer to 'the Fed decision this week' and a 'post-Fed reassessment' from the 10-28 meeting. VOO and VTI store the 200-day as 727.64 while the analyst now reads 727.98. (3) I wrote mark-relative percentages into stored text, such as '~$333 mark' and 'about 9% under the ~$700 mark'. By the close they were already off (9.1% and 8.1%), which is the drift L5 warns about. (4) My VNQ mark ($96.3, from pre-open market_value/qty) differed from the Proposer's ($97.3, from the market data) by about 1%. It did not change any call, but it is the same source-of-mark problem L5 records.
lessons: Write fixed-anchor stops only into stored invalidations: a dollar level plus its distance from the actual fill. Distances measured from 'the ~$X mark' go stale by the next close, as DPZ and IDXX did on 11-10.

On a day with a dated macro shock (CPI, payrolls, a Fed decision), say explicitly whether each rate- or macro-conditioned clause has tripped, and why: BND's Market-Analyst-plus-200-day clause, IEF's 'hawkish Fed' clause and VNQ's 'hot inflation' clause. A vague clause like IEF's 'yields materially higher' should be replaced in thesis_updates with a measurable one (for example, TLT or IEF more than 3% below its 200-day).

Write the SPY 200-day invalidation for VOO and VTI as 'SPY closes below its 200-day SMA as the regime filter computes it', with the number only as a dated reference. The average moves every day, so a stored figure goes stale without anyone making an error.

The 'distance on a mark 4-5% lower' check from L5 fits equities, but it overstates the risk for BND and IEF, where a 1.6-1.7% cushion is several weeks of normal moves (BND annual vol about 4%). For bond funds, give the distance in daily volatility units, or as the yield move that would trip the stop, rather than as a reason to trim pre-emptively.

When the stored text still carries conditional fill wording (MSM 'roughly $108 only if it fills near the menu close'), fix it in thesis_updates at the next run. L1 was applied to VNQ today but not to MSM, which has carried that wording since 10-27.
